speaker: Doctor
text: Did the onset of your vertigo episodes last only seconds to minutes, or did they persist for hours? Additionally, have you noticed any recent onset of tinnitus or a fullness sensation in the affected ear?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Episodes of dizziness and spinning sensation. I also have Position dependent vertigo, No recent illness, No hearing loss besides presbycusis.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV)

The brief, position-dependent nature of your vertigo without auditory symptoms like tinnitus or hearing loss, combined with your age, strongly points to displaced otoliths in the semicircular canals. I will recommend a Dix-Hallpike maneuver to confirm this clinical diagnosis.
